messages.subject: New psycholinguistic paper using Stan
parts:
Here is a new paper using Stan that was just accepted:

@article{HofmeisterVasishth2014,
  author = {Philip Hofmeister and Shravan Vasishth},
  title = {Distinctiveness and encoding effects in online sentence comprehension},
  year = {2014},
  pages = {n/a},
  note = {accepted in Frontiers Special Issue, http://journal.frontiersin.org/ResearchTopic/1545},
  pdf = { http://privatewww.essex.ac.uk/~phofme/encoding-frontiers-final.pdf},
  code = {http://privatewww.essex.ac.uk/~phofme/Univ3-Frontiers.zip}
}
